listing.summary: I personally don't understand why smaller ships shouldn't last as long in battle as bigger ships, and I dislike having wolfpack strategies fail against endgame enemies because my ships ran out of PPT even with Hardened Subsystems, Combat Endurance, not using Safety Overrides, etc.
listing.aiSummary: Increases Peak Performance Time for frigates, destroyers, and cruisers to help smaller ships survive longer in battle.

descriptionHtml:
I personally don't understand why smaller ships shouldn't last as long in battle as bigger ships, and I dislike having wolfpack strategies fail against endgame enemies because my ships ran out of PPT even with Hardened Subsystems, Combat Endurance, not using Safety Overrides, etc. I made this small script that increases PPT for all ships programmatically:
Frigates: +20% (rounded to nearest multiple of 10) but capped at 400 (because of Monitor).
Destroyers: +10% (rounded to nearest multiple of 10).
Cruisers: +5% (rounded to nearest multiple of 10).
Capitals: No change.

Here are the script contents before being compiled (I detest java):
Spoiler
package data.scripts.plugins;

import com.fs.starfarer.api.BaseModPlugin;
import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipHullSpecAPI;
import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI.HullSize;

public class ISSPPT_ModPlugin extends BaseModPlugin {

    @Override
    public void onApplicationLoad() throws Exception {
        // Iterate through all the ship hull specifications loaded by the game.
        for (ShipHullSpecAPI hullSpec : Global.getSettings().getAllShipHullSpecs()) {
            
            // Get the ship's original Peak Performance Time.
            float originalPPT = hullSpec.getNoCRLossSeconds();
            float newPPT = originalPPT;

            // Check the hull size and apply changes accordingly.
            if (hullSpec.getHullSize() == HullSize.FRIGATE) {
                // REFINED LOGIC: Only modify frigates if their original PPT is less than the 400s cap.
                if (originalPPT < 400f) {
                    // Frigates: +20%, rounded to nearest 10, capped at 400.
                    newPPT = originalPPT * 1.2f;
                    newPPT = Math.round(newPPT / 10f) * 10;
                    newPPT = Math.min(newPPT, 400f); // Cap the result.
                }

            } else if (hullSpec.getHullSize() == HullSize.DESTROYER) {
                // Destroyers: +10%, rounded to nearest 10.
                newPPT = originalPPT * 1.1f;
                newPPT = Math.round(newPPT / 10f) * 10;

            } else if (hullSpec.getHullSize() == HullSize.CRUISER) {
                // Cruisers: +5%, rounded to nearest 10.
                newPPT = originalPPT * 1.05f;
                newPPT = Math.round(newPPT / 10f) * 10;
            }

            // If the PPT has changed, apply the new value.
            if (newPPT != originalPPT) {
                hullSpec.setNoCRLossSeconds(newPPT);
            }
        }
    }
}

I have a compiled version that I can potentially upload, but I'm feeling too lazy to create another repository account, and I am not going to put this in the account I use for work stuff. Is it acceptable to provide something like "mega" or "rapidshare" link to the archive file?
